data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1: tests/runners/fixtures/ contains >=1 schema-valid case on each of the 3 axes (passing, RED-marker, skipping), each with a metadata record carrying id, verdict, harnesses, description
- dd-2: a metadata record whose verdict token is outside {pass,fail,skip} is rejected with a loud non-zero error rather than silently accepted

## Description
Implement Proposal 1 (single corpus-index.yaml + stdlib hand-rolled validator). Artifacts:
1. tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml — single source of truth. Top-level YAML list; each entry {id, verdict, harnesses (LIST), description, file: <relative path to fixture>, drift_ticket? optional}. >=1 entry per axis: pass->passing/pass-case-001.sh, fail->red-marker/red-case-001.sh, skip->skipping/skip-case-001.sh.
2. tests/runners/fixtures/passing/pass-case-001.sh, tests/runners/fixtures/red-marker/red-case-001.sh, tests/runners/fixtures/skipping/skip-case-001.sh — flat fixtures, NO embedded metadata.
3. tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py — stdlib-only (yaml.safe_load + hand-rolled checks), takes a positional path argument defaulting to corpus-index.yaml, mirroring the existing plugins/dso/scripts/check-corpus-schema.py (yaml.safe_load + frozenset membership + sys.exit loud rejection). Checks: required keys present; verdict in frozenset {pass,fail,skip}; each file path exists; each harnesses id in the manifest-derived id set from plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml — GATE THIS CROSS-CHECK ON MANIFEST EXISTENCE so it degrades to presence-only when the manifest is absent (the manifest may not yet be in-tree); assert all 3 axes have >=1 case. On violation: sys.exit(1) with one-line `CORPUS SCHEMA ERROR: <id>: ...` naming the offending file/id.
4. tests/runners/test-corpus-schema.sh — behavioral RED test (see TDD approach). Uses mktemp for temp copies.
Set executable bit on validate-corpus.py and test-corpus-schema.sh. Corpus is a PROTECTED hand-curated artifact (documented in task-3 README).

## Bundling rationale (Gate-2-justified)
task-1 wires .test-index with validate-corpus.py->test-corpus-schema.sh; committing the validator without the co-created test would leave the test gate pointing at a missing file, violating Gate-2 (intermediate broken state). Hence validator+corpus+fixtures+test are bundled in one atomic commit. RED-task model: co-creates test+implementation; committed state is GREEN (test passes once validator exists).

## TDD Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the real corpus-index.yaml with one valid entry per axis; When test-corpus-schema.sh runs validate-corpus.py against it; Then exit 0 (dd-1 3-axis coverage + required keys). And Given an mktemp temp copy with one entry's verdict mutated to 'bogus'; When the validator runs on the temp copy; Then non-zero exit AND output contains 'CORPUS SCHEMA ERROR' naming the offending id (dd-2). Also: malformed/unparseable corpus -> non-zero (no silent crash).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] validate-corpus.py and test-corpus-schema.sh exist and are executable
  Verify: test -x tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py && test -x tests/runners/test-corpus-schema.sh
- [ ] All three axis fixture files exist
  Verify: test -f tests/runners/fixtures/passing/pass-case-001.sh && test -f tests/runners/fixtures/red-marker/red-case-001.sh && test -f tests/runners/fixtures/skipping/skip-case-001.sh
- [ ] corpus-index.yaml has >=1 entry per axis verdict
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; e=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml')); assert isinstance(e,list); v={x['verdict'] for x in e}; assert {'pass','fail','skip'}<=v, v"
- [ ] Every metadata record has id/verdict/harnesses/description and harnesses is a list (dd-1)
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; e=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml')); assert isinstance(e,list); assert all({'id','verdict','harnesses','description'}<=set(x) for x in e); assert all(isinstance(x['harnesses'],list) for x in e)"
- [ ] Validator exits 0 on the real corpus (explicit path arg)
  Verify: python3 tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml
- [ ] RED test asserts the bad-verdict rejection (assertion context)
  Verify: grep -Eq 'assert.*bogus|CORPUS SCHEMA ERROR' tests/runners/test-corpus-schema.sh
- [ ] test-corpus-schema.sh exits 0 (committed GREEN; behavioral gate for 3-axis coverage + loud rejection)
  Verify: bash tests/runners/test-corpus-schema.sh
- [ ] Validator loudly rejects an out-of-enum verdict with non-zero exit naming the offending id (dd-2)
  Verify: T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/corpus.XXXXXX") && python3 -c "import yaml,sys; e=yaml.safe_load(open('tests/runners/fixtures/corpus-index.yaml')); assert isinstance(e,list); e[0]['verdict']='bogus'; yaml.safe_dump(e,open(sys.argv[1],'w'))" "$T" && OUT=$(python3 tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py "$T" 2>&1); RC=$?; rm -f "$T"; [ $RC -ne 0 ] && printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -q 'CORPUS SCHEMA ERROR'
- [ ] Validator exits non-zero and emits an error message on malformed YAML
  Verify: T=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/corpus.XXXXXX") && printf 'this: is: not: valid: yaml: [\n' > "$T" && OUT=$(python3 tests/runners/fixtures/validate-corpus.py "$T" 2>&1); RC=$?; rm -f "$T"; [ $RC -ne 0 ] && printf '%s' "$OUT" | grep -Eiq 'error|invalid|parse|yaml'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Create schema-validated single-oracle fixture corpus (3 axes) with stdlib validate-corpus.py and RED test
